selection: Six new internally constructed tasks on reused pinned real source repositories; no model has attempted these task IDs. Not random external issues or previously unseen repositories. Known diagnostics and local controls remain separate. No replacement tasks or post-result paid retries.
decision: Keep all failures/timeouts/missing usage and planned unexecuted rows. Use all assigned rows for primary success; compare resources only on audit-success/accounting-matched pairs. Report within-task repeat variation and between-task heterogeneity separately. Two tasks and two repetitions are a limited confirmation, not a population or global proof. A confidence interval crossing no improvement is inconclusive, not equivalence. Output bounds may regress long-generation quality.
accounting: USD .27 reserved before every new trial (.04 SDK soft session allowance plus .23 conservative final catalog-request reserve); missing aggregate reserves .27. Estimates are not invoices; provider revision/enforcement/hidden retries/full cache accounting remain unknown. Fresh phase, no performance pooling with old campaigns.
quality: Official success, independent functional criteria, actual final-source commands, absence of solution retrieval, and full audited user criteria remain separate. F23 explicitly requires correct active-case summary counts; this is preregistered, not post-hoc wording sensitivity.
intervention: Header-only reading improves complete exact API inventories without changing source or losing declared type information. Measure requested/rendered views, header bytes, JSON correctness, tokens/cost/time at matched audited quality.
taskOrder: Two fixed tasks; repetition2 reverses task and arm order. Three arms serially. No model requests overlap.

Use JSON shape {"functions":[{"path":"...","name":"...","signature":"..."}]}, with exactly those keys. The signature is the actual declaration header from the function keyword through its generic parameters, parameter types and declared return annotation, excluding the body opening brace. Whitespace and optional trailing commas may be normalized, and the export/default prefix may be omitted. Do not infer absent return types or include implementation text. Do not modify source, tests, manifests, dependencies or generated files; create only api-contracts.json.
